about: The Final Hour's standing torches (2026-10-01, asked: "ställ ut några facklor i det rummet där bossen är"). Higgsfield gpt_image_2_5, variant flare, quality medium, 1k, aspect 9:16, background transparent, 0.5 credit each. Style references: assets/city/wall_torch.png and assets/city/hall_brazier.png, flattened onto light grey and uploaded as image_references. Prompt: 'A standing torch for a dark fantasy RPG, painted in exactly the same style as the two reference images ... a torch exactly like the reference torch - wooden shaft wrapped in leather and iron bands, caged iron basket at the top, burning with a lively flame - standing upright, its foot set into a squat square block of dark grey carved stone with an iron collar holding the shaft ... front view, slightly from above ... isolated on a fully transparent background'. Game copy: alpha 254 rescaled to 255, haze under 6 dropped, tight crop, LANCZOS to 560 px tall. The flame is the top fifth of the picture; game.js sways it in slices and lays a glow round it and a pool of light on the floor.

alternatives.note: a slim iron torch stand on a three-legged clawed base
